segment: pitcher_id x batter_hand -- pitcher_hand is determined by pitcher_id, so this is each pitcher's own platoon split

controls.mass: renormalise mode holds the total correction weight at one
controls.shrinkage: placebo_batter_parity and placebo_day_parity split each pitcher by a meaningless row-derived bit, matching cell count and shrinkage with no content
controls.marginal: handedness_only and pitcher_only run the same grid

caveat_2022: the 2022 fold receives no calibration, so it reads exactly +0.00 for every candidate and only two folds are informative; the same was true of V156's experience segment, which returned +1.33
